newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash January wheat slips in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash January wheat slips in thin trade.

text.p: Argentine cash January wheat slipped in slow trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with exporters unhurried to buy, traders said.

Spot cash maize firmed as some exporters rushed to buy, but new crop maize was unchanged. There was good demand for both old and new crop soybeans but the market was rendered lifeless by the wait for upcoming USDA data. May soybeans slipped. Cash sunflower seed followed soybeans, with new crop prices easing.
